items.teaser: Russia will continue to provide military backing to the junta-led governments of Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger, which have formed a breakaway regional alliance that has strained ties with the West, the countries said Wednesday. The post Russia says to continue support for Burkina

items.headline: Nigeria flared 5.3 billion cubic metres of gas worth $1.5 billion in 2024
items.teaser: German Ambassador to Nigeria, Annett Günther, has disclosed that Nigeria lost an estimated $1.5 billion to gas flaring in 2024 after burning 5.3 billion cubic metres of associated gas, ranking the country seventh globally in gas flare volumes. Günther made the disclosure on Wedne
